description: Parameter sets of test case HT-002. Every value is an illustrative test value, not a selected device parameter. 'sat01_like' follows the materials, optical properties and connections of the Sat01 example assets in tests/data/simready with the surface areas and body normals written out directly. 'battery_example' replaces node B and path BR by the battery example of thermal design 4.3: C_B = 1000 J/K from one 1 kg portion at 1000 J/(kg K), the material example of design 4.5, and R_BR = 0.5 K/W.
